label: r04-F-T3-1
critiques: trialPrompt never names any spe/ file. It says "You may read only files under triage/ and ${OUT_DIR}/. Do not open, list, or search any other path." That allowlist excludes grade.py, answers.json, judge.md and the predictions. The grade step also scans the driver transcript and the triage transcript for "spe/evals/" or "spe/predictions/" in tool inputs, and voids and halts on any hit.

Gate 3 is a dry run with only: ["B:T001", "C2:T002", "C2:T003"], trials: 1 and topUpMax: 0. It runs before the full launch, and buildBaseItems honors ONLY. The full run proceeds only after the dry run's checks pass.

Gate 1 is a grader selftest. It requires 50/50 on the answers and requires failures on an empty output and on shifted labels. Gate 2 is the control. It regrades round 3's saved outputs with this round's grade.py and compares the result to round 3's recorded scores.

CAP_USD defaults to 40. reserve() runs before every trial and every judge call. It checks spent + reserved + usd > cap, skips the call when the cap would be crossed, pushes the skip with its reason into budget.skipped, and halts with a log line. budget.skipped is returned in the summary.

gradeTrial runs grade.py against answers.json to check category and priority, and those results set label_pass. The judge prompt says "Judge tone only. Code grades category and priority elsewhere." It also forbids reading the label and answers.json.

The Top-up phase selects cells where passes > 0 && passes < c.length. It adds TOPUP_MAX trials per cell, with the default of 3 stated in the args comment and in the log. Top-up is skipped when the run has halted.

The Synthesis phase runs prediction scoring, then failure analysis, then a completeness critic. The round comes from one argument, const ROUND = Number(args.round), and RR, NEXT and PRED_PATH are derived from it.
